name: kxvenezuelaleader
title: Who will officially lead Venezuela at the end of 2026?
settlement: Resolves Yes for the person who officially holds the position of head of state of Venezuela on Dec 31, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET. Officially holding means formally appointed and sworn in, listed as head of state in authoritative government sources, or actively serving with full authority. Nominated, designated, acting or interim, or future-dated appointments do not count unless explicitly specified.
decideContext: Estimate how a news item shifts the probability that a given candidate is Venezuela's officially recognized head of state on Dec 31, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET. Exactly one candidate market resolves Yes, so the probabilities across candidates sum to 100%.
